caption:
Compete with others, but in good deeds

Every nation has a direction it turns to. Allah tells us to compete with one another in good deeds, and wherever we are, He will bring us all together.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:148

Which good deed will you get to first today?

#gooddeeds #competeingood #surahbaqarah #mondaymotivation

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: Every nation has a direction to which it turns, so compete with one another in good deeds. Wherever you are, Allah will bring you all together, for Allah is Most Capable of all things (Surah Al-Baqara 2:148)
